botcomponent.description: Use when the user asks to turn analysis results, metrics, or findings into a polished, presentation-ready report, one-pager, or executive summary -- especially when existing analysis (e.g. from the spreadsheet analysis skill) needs to become a document someone will actually read. Builds a branded PDF with reportlab from a short content file (headline, KPI tiles, one chart per point, data notes and the non-audit disclaimer) using the shared brand tokens, and runs a QA pass before delivery to catch walls of text, chart clutter, low-resolution charts, missing data notes or poor contrast. Do NOT use for a quick inline chat answer, a single ad-hoc chart with no report structure around it, a raw data export with no narrative, or to compute the figures themselves.
botcomponent.name: polished-report-builder
